new_support_cap_proof.statement: Genuine same-reference completion of finite support-plane caps with rational barycentric gradient coordinates, despite irrational maximum walls.
new_support_cap_proof.proof:
Write the ACTUAL convex gamma on its fixed finite rational carrier Sigma, with affine data (a_sigma,b_sigma), and list its finitely many supporting gradients a_j. For each chosen plane ell_i=p_i.x-c_i require p_i=sum_j alpha_ij a_j with RATIONAL alpha_ij>=0 and sum_j alpha_ij=1. Constants c_i can be arbitrary REAL. Fix a positive rational C0 and H=max(gamma-C0,ell_1,...,ell_m). H is a continuous convex function bounded relative to ACTUAL gamma, but its maximum walls may be irrational; it is NOT declared primitive PA.
Each cell sigma is pointed by gamma positive growth, and has finitely many rational vertices v and rational recession generators r. Put z_{sigma,i}=ell_i-gamma_sigma. Every recession slope z_{sigma,i}(r)<=0 because p_i belongs to the recession polytope P=conv{a_j} and gamma infinity(r)=a_sigma.r on rec(sigma). The equalities for zero slopes and inequalities for the other slopes are RATIONAL LINEAR constraints in gamma affine parameters, since every alpha_ij,r,v and carrier incidence is rational. Append these constraints to the full carrier continuity/PC coefficient cone. The ACTUAL gamma is feasible. In its smallest rational face, rational points arbitrarily close to gamma have EXACTLY all its zero recession constraints and preserve all finite strictly negative slopes. The same elementary rational-simplex construction proved in S272 produces an EXACT positive REAL convex combination gamma=sum_s t_s gamma_s, sum_s t_s=1, with all gamma_s RATIONAL PA PC on Sigma, arbitrarily close in every finite parameter, and positive growth. Properness persists by strictly positive bounds on the finitely many recession generators. This uses the whole rational-face argument with the additional explicit constraints; it does not assume that gamma_s-gamma is globally bounded.
Set p_is=sum_j alpha_ij a_js in P_s. Choose rational c_is close to each c_i and put H_s=max(gamma_s-C0,p_1s.x-c_1s,...,p_ms.x-c_ms). Each H_s is ACTUAL finite rational PA on rational geometry, convex/PC and bounded relative to gamma_s; every active zero recession equality remains exact. The finite sum theta=sum_s t_s H_s is a genuine REAL PA PC function on the common finite rational refinement, with reference sum_s t_s gamma_s=ACTUAL gamma. Thus theta is in the finite primitive domain before any operator is assigned to H.
Here is the needed GLOBAL uniform estimate, not merely convergence on compact sets. For each sigma and i, write any x in sigma as a convex combination of its vertices plus sum_r beta_r r, beta_r>=0. If old z at that vertex combination is z_V and T=-sum beta_r z(r)>=0, then z(x)=z_V-T. Zero recession slopes stay EXACTLY zero. For the strictly negative slopes, sufficiently close parameters give relative errors <=eta: |z_s(r)-z(r)|<=eta |z(r)|. Vertex/constant errors are <=eta after choosing the finite approximations sufficiently close. Hence |z_s(x)-z(x)|<=eta(1+T). Let B bound |z_V| over all finitely many sigma/i/vertices. If T>2(B+C0+2) and eta<=1/2, both z and z_s are below -C0, so their clipped values max(-C0,z) are identical. Otherwise their clipped difference is <=eta[1+2(B+C0+2)]. The same bound holds for the finite maximum over i, uniformly over ALL x and cells. Consequently ||(H_s-gamma_s)-(H-gamma)||_infinity tends to zero. Summing the positive weights gives ||theta-H||_infinity->0 while keeping ACTUAL gamma EXACTLY fixed. This proves H in S272 genuine GLOBAL completion. No primitive use of an irrational wall, no reference substitution, and no uniform control of unbounded gamma_s-gamma is presumed.

entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.statement: Full affine sector with ACTUAL arbitrary REAL PA convex positive-growth reference on rational geometry.
entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.proof: Work on X=R^d with its full standard rational affine structure, d>=1, and positive constant top-cycle weight w. A finite balanced full-dimensional decomposition of the whole affine space has the same weight on adjacent top cells by primitive codimension-one balance, so this is also the exact full-support positive balanced category after refining. For a continuous function, printed PC implies ordinary LOCAL convexity even if the fixed carrier must be refined rather than coarsened. Around x in the relative interior of a face tau, a small ball meets only cells incident to tau. Rational centers in tau are dense. Rational small opposite displacements satisfying the incident-cell inequalities approximate every real opposite displacement, because these are finite rational polyhedral cone constraints. Printed PCC with endpoints q-h,q+h and real weights 1/2 then gives the local midpoint inequality; continuity passes rational centers/endpoints to x and arbitrary sufficiently small displacements. Continuous local midpoint convexity gives local convexity by dyadic weights. Restricting to any compact line segment and partitioning it into finitely many such neighborhoods makes secant slopes nondecreasing across the partition, hence gives global convexity. Ordinary convexity implies every printed PCC inequality. This argument does not authorize coarsening a required carrier or assume all original distant endpoint tuples are themselves legal. No analogous ambient-convex conclusion is asserted on branched or merely embedded supports. The ACTUAL reference gamma is continuous convex finite REAL PA on finite rational geometry, with arbitrary REAL affine coefficients and positive growth gamma>=a|x|-b, a>0. Actual gamma stays fixed. Generated rational-slope PA functions belong to S272 explicit real/rational-denominator primitive sector after denominator clearing. This is NOT a density assertion inside the literal integral-slope-only category, the REAL-reference extension is explicitly proved below rather than obtained by unbounded slope perturbation.

entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.statement: A finite lower-semicontinuous convex function on a compact polytope is continuous on the entire polytope.
entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.proof: Let P be a compact polytope and g:P->R finite, convex and lower semicontinuous. If v_i are its finitely many vertices, convexity gives g<=B=max_i g(v_i). Fix x in P. Write P in its affine span by finitely many inequalities l_i>=0. Choose r>0 smaller than every positive slack l_i(x)/(2||dl_i||); zero covectors cause no restriction. For y in P sufficiently close to x, t=|y-x|/r<1 and z=x+(y-x)/t satisfy every active inequality (because y does) and every inactive inequality by the slack bound. Thus z in P and y=(1-t)x+t z. Hence g(y)<=g(x)+t(B-g(x)), so limsup_{y->x}g(y)<=g(x). Lower semicontinuity supplies liminf>=g(x). The degenerate zero-dimensional case is immediate. This proves full relative continuity; compactness makes it uniform. It does not use the false assertion that arbitrary convex functions are continuous at boundary points without lower semicontinuity.

entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.statement: GLOBAL genuine REAL PA regularization of EVERY continuous convex f bounded relative to arbitrary ACTUAL real-coefficient reference gamma.

Triangulate P using its original vertices, which are among the finitely many a_j, and take iterated barycentric subdivisions. Every mesh vertex p_i has RATIONAL barycentric coordinates in the a_j, although p_i itself need not be rational. Mesh tends to zero by the nested-face barycenter estimate already proved in283.
Let q_n(x)=max_{p_i in V_n}(p_i.x-f*(p_i)). The convex-combination/modulus calculation of283 is unchanged: 0<=f-q_n<=omega(mesh_n) at EVERY x, not only on compact sets. This uses exact sampled REAL gradients, not an approximation of the recession polytope. Choose a rational C0>C. Then H_n=max(gamma-C0,q_n) still satisfies ||H_n-f||_infinity<=omega(mesh_n). Each H_n has finitely many support planes with rational barycentric gradient coordinates, so E1 independently constructs genuine finite same-ACTUAL-gamma REAL PA PC theta_n with ||theta_n-H_n||_infinity<=2^-n. A diagonal choice yields theta_n->f globally uniformly with one common relative bound. Each theta_n has rational geometry inherited from its actual rational-component maxima, not the possibly irrational geometry of H_n. A dyadic subsequence with error<=2^-n and shift4*2^-n gives an actual nonincreasing primitive sequence above f. Thus f belongs to the declared genuine GLOBAL D_R(gamma) BEFORE any MA is formed, for arbitrary actual REAL reference. This does not use a decomposition f=sum_s t_s f_s, which is not justified by a reference Minkowski decomposition.

entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.statement: Finite rational-PA obstacles have genuinely finite REAL PA envelopes on rational geometry, even for arbitrary ACTUAL real reference.
entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.proof:
Let u be continuous finite rational PA compact-supported, |u|<=C, and F=ACTUAL gamma+u. Refine the finite rational carrier so F is affine on each cell sigma. Cells are pointed by gamma growth, with rational base vertices v and rational recession generators r. Although F has REAL affine coefficients, the epigraph on sigma is explicitly generated by (v,F(v)), (r,F_infinity(r)) and the vertical ray (0,1). Its vertex/ray HEIGHTS may be irrational but every spatial projection is rational. The closed convex hull of the finite union is the real polyhedron Q=conv(all lifted vertices)+cone(all lifted rays); the finite-generator/closure argument of283 R4 does not require rational heights. Q is upward closed, contains epi(gamma+C), and lies inside epi(gamma-C). Hence it is epi(q), the finite continuous convex envelope, with |q-gamma|<=C.
Every lower face of Q is generated by a subset of those lifted vertices/rays. A face with downward-facing normal excludes the vertical ray, so its projection is conv(a subset of the rational base vertices)+cone(a subset of the rational spatial rays). It is a RATIONAL spatial polyhedron. On every full-dimensional lower-face projection, q is affine with REAL coefficients. There are finitely many faces; their common refinement gives finite RATIONAL geometry and continuous REAL PA q. This is the explicit geometric reason q is an ACTUAL finite primitive-sector function, despite irrational epigraph heights; no claim that Q itself is a rational polyhedron is made. R230 with all qualifications identifies q with the ACTUAL unrestricted printed envelope, using the same two inequalities as283 R4, without requiring individual unrestricted competitors to be continuous. Thus finite-obstacle envelopes receive their raw measure in the ACTUAL finite REAL PA domain before any continuous limit. This argument does not apply on a branched support.

entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.statement: Every flat PC jet has zero raw atom on the full affine support, at every rational point and EVERY rational tangent refinement.
entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.proof:
Fix any rational point and any finite rational refinement. A convex finite PA germ h at that point, after subtracting its value, is max of finitely many active real linear gradients, so its subgradient set is their convex hull. If a nontrivial printed flat relation is given by nonzero rational tangent vectors b_i and positive real alpha_i with sum alpha_i b_i=0 and sum alpha_i h(b_i)=0, then for every subgradient p, each h(b_i)-p.b_i>=0 and their positively weighted sum is zero. Thus p.b_i=h(b_i) for every active i and every p. Choose one nonzero rational b=b_i and one p0 in the subgradient polytope. The germ h-p0.x is invariant along R b, since all its linear gradients annihilate b. The common linear part has zero primitive derivative on EVERY balanced intermediate signed cycle.
Take a product rational fan in the quotient by the saturated rational line R b. The full top-cycle [R^d] of weight w and every cycle produced by successive raw primitive derivatives of the invariant germ retain this lineality. Indeed cells/faces and the derivative data pull back from the quotient, and the inward saturated primitive normal calculation changes only quotient coordinates; balancing removes any linear contribution. This is a direct unit-by-unit primitive calculation, including signed and zero intermediate cycles, not an ordinary nonsaturated normal formula. A nonzero finite zero-dimensional fan cycle cannot have a nonzero lineality direction. After d derivatives the cycle is therefore zero. Subdivision invariance in S272 gives the same zero raw atom on the original refinement. This proves the full quantified flat-jet condition, without replacing all refinements by one fan, and without invoking an unproved Alexandrov-volume identity. S272 finite-PA contact iff now applies to EVERY actual finite-PA measured envelope in R4.

entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.statement: Bounded local-uniform obstacles imply bounded local-uniform actual convex envelopes; explicit tail estimate.
entire_nine_full_affine_proof_units.proof:
Set H=gamma+c>=0 proper. The actual convex envelope of F=gamma+u is the infimum of expected F under finite barycentric probabilities with barycenter x, including the no-op delta_x. This follows directly: that infimum is convex, bounded between gamma-C and F, and every convex minorant is bounded above by it by Jensen. Its finiteness makes it continuous. R230 identifies the unrestricted envelope with this convex roof exactly as in R4: the actual envelope is continuous PC and hence convex, and the roof itself is an eligible PC minorant. Rational endpoints suffice in the printed problem, because continuity and rational enclosing simplices approximate any finite configuration while maintaining the exact real barycenter; or ordinary convexity can be used after R1. These probabilities are ordinary convex/PCC coefficients, NOT MA measures.
If ||u||,||v||<=C, every epsilon-optimal probability nu for u has int H dnu<=H(x)+2C+epsilon by P_u(x)<=gamma(x)+C and -u<=C. Hence nu{H>R}<=(H(x)+2C+epsilon)/R. Evaluate the same probability for v, let epsilon decrease to zero, and reverse u/v to obtain |P_u(x)-P_v(x)|<=sup_{H<=R}|u-v|+2C(H(x)+2C)/R. This is uniform on every compact set of x. Thus uniformly bounded obstacles converging locally uniformly, including nets, have locally uniformly convergent ACTUAL envelopes, with the same relative bound C. It asserts no global uniform density in C_b.

Thus int(P_gamma(u)-(gamma+u)) MA_raw(P_gamma(u))=0 for EVERY bounded continuous obstacle, with unchanged raw mass M, actual envelope and actual established operator. steps.statement: On a finite union of independent complete rational affine d-planes through a rational common origin, a continuous function is printed-PC exactly when every branch restriction is ordinary convex and all origin values agree.
steps.proof: Translate the rational origin to zero and identify saturated branch lattices. Independence means the sum of the branch linear spaces is direct; it does not mean only pairwise zero intersections. Necessity of branch convexity follows by the complete local rational-midpoint argument R1 in the whole joint proof below, using the inherited rational branch complex: every such local branch PCC is also a PCC of X, and continuity gives ordinary local convexity and then segment convexity on the complete branch. This uses refinement and incidence, not coarsening. Origin agreement follows from continuity/single-valuedness. Conversely let each branch function be convex with the same value a at zero. For a printed legal PCC centered at x!=0, its center face contains a nonzero point on a unique branch. Every incident endpoint cell therefore lies on that branch, so convexity applies. At x=0 group endpoints by branch (zero endpoints may be assigned anywhere), and put A_i=sum of the group weights. Direct-sum independence of the barycentric zero equation gives sum_{j in i} alpha_j x_j=0 in EACH branch. For A_i>0, ordinary convexity gives sum_{j in i} alpha_j f_i(x_j)>=A_i a. Sum the finite inequalities; discard zero coefficients and empty groups. Thus the origin PCC is valid. Cells of an arbitrary refinement remain contained in individual branches, since a connected positive-dimensional convex cell cannot leave one branch through its sole intersection point without including a segment outside X. A lower-dimensional origin cell is common; all other cells are unique. This proves sufficiency for every printed rational refinement and all actual real relation weights.

This is a working proof dependency included in full, not an accepted sixth grant. It supplies actual finite rational-geometry real PA convex q_{i,n} with global error at most eta_n/2, eta_n=2^-n. Let a=f(0), a single real number. Define theta_{i,n}=q_{i,n}-q_{i,n}(0)+a. Its error from f_i is at most eta_n everywhere, and its origin value is EXACTLY a on EVERY branch. No rational approximation of a is required in PA_R. Refine the finite rational carrying complexes to contain the rational origin as a face; affine formulas are unchanged and no irrational wall is introduced. Since there are finitely many independent branches, their union is a finite rational common complex. The theta_{i,n} glue to a continuous real PA function theta_n; B1 gives PC. It is boundedly relative to the ACTUAL gamma with global error at most eta_n from f. Define F_n=theta_n+4eta_n. Then 3eta_n<=F_n-f<=5eta_n globally. As eta_{n+1}=eta_n/2, F_{n+1}-f<=2.5eta_n<3eta_n<=F_n-f, so F_n decreases everywhere (strictly by at least eta_n/2) to f uniformly on ALL X. These are genuine actual-reference PA_R PC approximants on rational spatial geometry. This is not a change of recession, an irrational max construction, a literal PA_Z approximation or a local-only completion. Constant shifts do not change branch growth. Arbitrary positive REAL constant branch weights affect only the raw cycle, not this construction.

steps.proof: Choose one branch Q_1 with weight c_1>0 and a nonzero rational line L in another branch. Direct-sum independence gives Q_1 intersect L=0. Extend the saturated dual coordinates of Q_1 to rational ambient forms ell_1,...,ell_d vanishing on every other branch; set h=sum|ell_j|. This ambient convex rational homogeneous PA germ is printed-PC, vanishes on both directions of L, and gives a legal flat origin PCC after rational refinement. On Q_1, the primitive raw divisor of |ell_j| is twice its primitive evaluation on its saturated kernel. In saturated coordinate bases that evaluation is1. Distinct-factor ordered products give 2^d delta_0; a repeated factor vanishes on its own kernel, and mixed commutativity puts repeats adjacent. There are d! distinct ordered terms in D_h^d, so its raw atom on Q_1 is c_1 2^d d!. On other complete branches every ell_j restricts to zero, so their contributions vanish. This is true primitive recursion, not an appended factorial or Alexandrov operator. S272 realizes this specific rational germ in a genuine finite relative REAL PA F with the SAME inserted germ in each reference summand, actual gamma unchanged, and atom delta^d c_1 2^d d!>0. The flat relation survives. Its granted roof construction gives u=F-gamma+(R-rho(x))_+ on rational geometry, with actual envelope F and raw contact integral EXACTLY -R delta^d c_1 2^d d!<0. Every endpoint here is already finite PA; alternatively B3 independently gives all-envelope domain membership. Positive growth, actual REAL coefficients and branch weights are retained. Thus regularity alone cannot imply contact, even with full all-C_b domain membership in this branching sector. For one branch, full all-C_b contact follows from the entire joint R4-R8 proof included below; this is not a claim of priority over the separate unreviewed282 affine-arrangement argument.
